description.value: At 19th level, a necromancer can actually guide the spirit of a slain creature back to its body a number of times per day equal to the necromancer's Charisma modifier, restoring the creature to life. This is only possible if the spirit is nearby, and thus this power must be used within 10 minutes since the creature's death. This functions like the Arise spell except the casting time is 1 full round. Once a creature has been restored to life by a necromancer's final guide ability, that creature cannot benefit from that ability again (from any necromancer) until 24 hours has passed.
